verdict.rationale: The VerificationSessions API is documented as tracking a verification from creation through completion: a curl example creates a session, status-change events and webhooks report its status, and results plus collected images can be retrieved programmatically with the secret key. Nothing in the pack documents cancelling or redacting a session; the only status control shown is a manual override in the review tools. missing for 10: documented cancel endpoint, documented redact endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API lifecycle.
